scripts.title: Speed Of Sound Round 2
scripts.script:
--//Custom Sonic LMS Music Script
--//Loops forever btw, only good for clips n stuff
 
local function loadCustomAsset(url, filename)
    if not isfile(filename) then
        writefile(filename, game:HttpGet(url))
    end
    return getcustomasset(filename)
end
 
--// edit this stuff below to link to an external mp3
local DEFAULT_MUSIC = loadCustomAsset(
    "https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/the-unofficial-outcome-memories/images/d/db/SpeedofSoundRound2.mp3/revision/latest?cb=20250920222145",
    "speedofsound.mp3"
)
 
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
 
local theme =
    ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ClientAssets")
    and ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets:FindFirstChild("Sounds")
    and ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds:FindFirstChild("mus")
    and ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus:FindFirstChild("Game")
    and ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus.Game:FindFirstChild("Round")
    and ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus.Game.Round:FindFirstChild("SoloTheme")
    and ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus.Game.Round.SoloTheme:FindFirstChild("SonicSolo")
 
if not theme then
    warn("LMS SonicSolo theme not found")
    return
end
 
theme:Stop()
theme.SoundId = DEFAULT_MUSIC
theme.Looped = false
theme.Volume = 2
theme:Play()

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then update(input) end
end)

title.Text = "Fly GUI"
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

local flyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
flyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8,0,0,40)
flyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.4,0)
flyBtn.Text = "Toggle Fly"

local close = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
close.Size = UDim2.new(0,30,0,30)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1,-30,0,0)
close.Text = "X"

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	gui:Destroy()
end)

-- Fly system
local bodyGyro
local bodyVel

local function startFly()
	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro", root)
	bodyGyro.P = 9e4
	bodyGyro.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
	bodyGyro.cframe = root.CFrame

	bodyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", root)
	bodyVel.velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
	bodyVel.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)

	while flying do
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		bodyGyro.cframe = cam.CFrame
		bodyVel.velocity = cam.CFrame.LookVector * speed
		task.wait()
	end
end

local function stopFly()
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end
	if bodyVel then bodyVel:Destroy() end
end

flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	flying = not flying
	
	if flying then
		startFly()
	else
		stopFly()
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local running = false

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "WallBuilderV2"
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0,200,0,120)

startBtn.Parent = frame

stopBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,30)
stopBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,45)
stopBtn.Text = "Stop"
stopBtn.Parent = frame

local unloadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
unloadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,30)
unloadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,80)
unloadBtn.Text = "Unload"
unloadBtn.Parent = frame


-- fire closest proximity prompt
local function fireClosestPrompt()
    local closest
    local dist = math.huge

    for _,v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and v.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
            local d = (hrp.Position - v.Parent.Position).Magnitude
            if d < dist then
                dist = d
                closest = v
            end
        end
    end

    if closest then
        fireproximityprompt(closest,1)
    end
end


local function run()
    while running do

        -- step 1
        char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-255,6,-139))
        task.wait(0.15)

        -- step 2
        fireClosestPrompt()
        task.wait(0.15)

        -- step 3 equip brick
        local tool = player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Brick")
        if tool then
            tool.Parent = char
        end

        task.wait(0.15)

        -- step 4 scan bricks
        local bricks = {}
        for _,v in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name:match("^Brick%d+$") then
                table.insert(bricks,v)
            end
        end

        if #bricks > 0 then
            local brick = bricks[math.random(1,#bricks)]

            local prompt = brick:FindFirstChild("PickupPrompt")
            if prompt then
                fireproximityprompt(prompt,1)
            end

            task.wait(0.15)

            -- tp to brick
            char:PivotTo(brick.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0))
            task.wait(0.15)

            -- fire again
            fireClosestPrompt()
        end

        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end


startBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not running then
        running = true
        task.spawn(run)
    end
end)

stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    running = false
end)

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    running = false
    gui:Destroy()
end)

scripts.title: Admin Panel  v1
scripts.features:
Script ini menghadirkan Admin Panel GUI dengan tampilan sederhana, clean, dan mudah digunakan. Panel ini berfokus pada fitur ESP untuk player dan berbagai object penting di dalam map, sehingga pemain dapat melihat informasi yang biasanya tidak terlihat secara langsung selama permainan berlangsung.

GUI dirancang dengan sistem toggle sehingga setiap fitur dapat diaktifkan atau dimatikan dengan mudah sesuai kebutuhan. Selain itu, panel juga memiliki beberapa menu tambahan seperti gameplay tools, teleport, settings, dan credits.

Fitur yang tersedia pada script ini meliputi:

• Killer ESP (Red)
Menampilkan posisi killer dengan highlight warna merah.

• Survivor ESP (Green)
Menampilkan posisi survivor dengan highlight warna hijau.

• Generator ESP (Orange)
Menunjukkan lokasi generator yang tersedia di map.

• Gate ESP (White)
Menampilkan posisi gate atau pintu keluar.

• Hook ESP (Red)
Menampilkan lokasi hook di area permainan.

• Show Only Closest Hook
Opsi untuk menampilkan hanya hook yang paling dekat dengan posisi player.

• Pallet ESP (Yellow)
Menunjukkan posisi pallet yang ada di map.

• Teleport Menu
Memungkinkan player untuk berpindah ke lokasi tertentu dengan lebih cepat.

• Gameplay Tools
Beberapa fitur tambahan untuk membantu gameplay.

• Settings & Customization
Pengaturan panel dan tampilan GUI.

Dan berbagai fitur tambahan lainnya yang dapat membantu pemain mendapatkan informasi map dengan lebih jelas selama permainan berlangsung.
